articles.summary: In this episode we chat to Mark Mukhija, CEO of Eagle Nuclear Energy, a company focused on uranium development and advanced nuclear technology. We discuss Eagle’s Aurora Uranium Project, its scale and pathway towards a pre-feasibility study, as well as the challenges of rebuilding a domestic U.S. uranium supply chain. articles.title: Dig Deep Mining Podcast – Fueling the Nuclear Renaissance: Rebuilding Domestic Supply with Eagle Nuclear Energy
